# The downtime pack

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

A printable copy of the last snapshot, for when the system is down: beds by ward, the ED queue, pending moves and legal forms.

## What is on the screen

1. When it was taken. The pack is a copy from this time. It does not update by itself.
2. New snapshot. The bed coordinator takes a new snapshot. Other desks see when the last one was taken.
3. Sections. Beds by ward, ED queue, pending movements and legal forms.
4. Print or save PDF. Keep a paper copy, or save it as a PDF to your service's approved downtime location.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
